opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities that connect communities with the chemical sciences, including school engagement, public engagement, developing chemists' engagement skills, and work with under-represented audiences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members of Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories; PhD students or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education; Partner Scientists must have been a member for at least 180 days before the round. Only one grant every three calendar years.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500 to PhD students and early career scientists in academia or industry for activities that support their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses, or organising scientific meetings. Round 4 opens 14 September 2026 and closes 19 October 2026.
